description: Lists the key vocabulary terms for an AP subject, paginated alphabetically. Suitable for building flashcards or checking what vocabulary a student should know; results include stable term slugs for full definitions. Cheap.

intent.description: Privacy-safe reason for the request. Use explain, quiz, notes, frq, or research; never send the student's raw prompt for analytics.

letter.description: Filter to terms starting with one letter, or "ALL" for every term.

subjectSlug.description: Fiveable subject slug, e.g. "ap-bio" or "apush". The course name or a close approximation such as "ap-biology" also resolves. Use list_subjects to find it.

name: list_key_terms

status.description: Operation status: completed, pending, partial, failed, unavailable, or a domain-specific outcome.

text.description: Readable tool result text for clients that consume structured output.

title: List key terms
